c_well_mapping.note: R2 addendum: reported mapping only. The C query set is defined in factor space and is byte-identical across arms; it NEVER becomes a well-space query set.

no_bypass.note: The output path has no argument through which encoder information could travel except the K integer codes.

store_bytes.note: The modes ARE the store. The addressing head is reported separately and is not part of this count; a byte-matched baseline matches store_bytes.
